items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: Man Cannonball to me was the consummate altoist. His tone, his sound, his approach.

ctx.x: Yeah. Man Cannonball to me was the consummate altoist. His tone, his sound, his approach. And you look at his career, you could apply that tone to jazz, R&B, classical. When you listen to some of those records he did in the 50s with strings, the things —
